papers.title: Assessing the Estimands and Estimates of Hospitalization Rates in Health Economics and Clinical Medicine.
papers.abstract: Even though data on hospital admissions are widely used in health research, hospitalization-related estimands measured using these data are not always clearly conceptualized. Consequently, estimators of these quantities can have unclear rationales and undesirable properties. We evaluate three "rate" estimators for measuring hospitalization-related estimands. Using the Grossman human capital model, we motivate the importance of measuring healthy time. We show that an upper bound on healthy time can be calculated using lengths of hospital stay without assumptions about health status outside the hospital. We illustrate the empirical value of these bounds. Next, we find that an admission rate conventionally used in clinical research is a patient follow-up time weighted average that lacks a clear basis for the weights. We propose an alternative estimator with more desirable properties and weaker assumptions. We assess its performance using a model of hospital admissions and death. Finally, we evaluate the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) use of risk-standardized readmission rates to penalize hospitals by showing that risk-standardized rates can be sensitive to patient case mix, potentially leading to hospital rankings that do not reflect hospital quality. We propose treating hospital specific intercepts in the CMS risk-standardization model as a measure of quality.
papers.summary: 本研究評估了衛生經濟學與臨床醫學中住院率相關的估算量與估算方法。作者利用Grossman人力資本模型闡述了測量「健康時間」的重要性，證明無需假設院外健康狀況即可透過住院天數計算健康時間的上限。研究發現臨床常用的住院率是基於患者隨訪時間的加權平均值，但其權重缺乏明確依據，因此提出了具備更優特性且假設條件更弱的替代估算量。此外，作者還評估了聯邦醫療保險和醫療補助服務中心（CMS）使用的風險標準化再入院率，指出其易受患者病例組合影響，並建議將模型中的醫院特定截距作為衡量醫院品質的指標。
papers.classification: 衛生經濟學與醫療評估
papers.significance: 此研究的重要性在於修正了醫療研究中廣泛使用卻往往概念不清的住院率測量方法，為研究者提供了理論上更健全的估算工具。透過重新定義健康時間界限與提出替代住院率估算量，該文解決了傳統方法中權重設定不合理的問題。特別是在醫院評鑑方面，研究揭示了CMS現行風險標準化再入院率的潛在偏差，提出改用截距作為品質衡量指標，這對於制定更精準的醫療支付政策與提升醫院排名的公平性具有重要意義。

papers.title: The Impact of Unemployment Insurance Benefit Cuts on Mental Health: Evidence From Early Pandemic Program Expirations.
papers.abstract: This study is the first to estimate the effects of unemployment insurance (UI) benefit contractions on mental health. We leverage a unique quasi-natural experiment: early termination of the Federal Pandemic Unemployment Compensation (FPUC) and Pandemic Unemployment Assistance (PUA) programs across more than 20 states during the summer of 2021. Using high-frequency data from the Census Bureau's Household Pulse Survey (HPS), our difference-in-differences estimates suggest that early withdrawal from FPUC and PUA increases the probability of reporting anxiety symptoms among working-age adults without a college degree, a group particularly vulnerable to unexpected income shocks. The adverse effects are more pronounced among racial and ethnic minorities, older individuals, and women. However, the increase in anxiety symptoms is short-lived, persisting for about 1 month after the benefit cessation. Finally, we find evidence that financial hardship is a likely mechanism underlying these findings.
papers.summary: 本研究首次估計了失業保險（UI）福利縮減對心理健康的影響。利用2021年夏季部分州提前終止聯邦大流行失業補償（FPUC）和大流行失業援助（PUA）作為準自然實驗，研究人員透過人口普查局家庭脈搏調查的高頻數據進行雙重差分分析。結果顯示，福利削減顯著增加了非大學學歷成年勞動力的焦慮症狀發生率，且對少數族裔、長者和女性的影響更為嚴重；儘管這些負面影響在福利停止一個月後逐漸消失，但研究證實經濟困難是導致這些問題的主要機制。
papers.significance: 該研究對於理解社會福利政策的社會成本具有重要貢獻，特別是強調了失業救濟削減對弱勢群體心理健康的短期衝擊。結果表明，雖然焦慮症狀的影響是暫時性的，但政策變動確實透過財務壓力渠道損害了公共衛生，為政策制定者在設計失業保險制度時平衡財政緊縮與心理健康支持提供了關鍵的實證參考。

papers.title: Do Patients Value the Service Provided by Physicians Who Overbill? A Willingness-to-Pay Study Using French Survey Data.
papers.abstract: Outpatient specialist physicians in France can work either in the regulated sector, where they charge the regulated fee, or in the unregulated sector, where they set their own fees above the regulated fee. This context provides a unique opportunity to estimate the extent to which patients value services provided under balance billing. In January 2021, we carried out a contingent valuation method (CVM) survey on a sample of 1051 individuals who were representative of France's adult population. Results highlighted that willingness-to-pay (WTP) for a specialist consultation in the unregulated sector was higher than for a consultation in the regulated sector, with a significant WTP difference of €4.30 (almost 15% of the regulated fee). This difference was significant across all respondent subgroups (i.e., gender, age, education level, marital status, income, health status, insurance coverage, and area of residence) and was not fully driven by differences in income. Moreover, this preference for the unregulated sector was associated with the perception that specialists in this sector provide better quality medical care, better quality non-medical services, and that making an appointment with them is easier. Finally, we estimated the patient net welfare gain generated by specialist consultations in the unregulated sector in France at approximately €165 million per year. This is the first study to provide an estimation of patients' benefits associated with balance billing.
papers.summary: 本研究利用法國調查數據分析患者對醫師超額收費服務的評價。結果顯示，受訪者對非監管部門專科診療的支付意願顯著高於監管部門，價差達4.30歐元。此偏好廣泛存在於各類族群，主要驅動因素為對更好醫療質量、非醫療服務及預約便利性的感知，而非單純的收入差異。研究估計該體制每年為患者創造約1.65億歐元的淨福利。
papers.significance: 本研究是首篇量化患者從醫療超額計費中獲得效益的文獻，填補了相關領域的空白。它揭示了患者願意支付溢價是為了獲取更優質的服務體驗，而這對於理解雙軌醫療體制下的社會福利分配及制定相關政策具有關鍵參考價值。

papers.title: Policy Progress in Using Economic Policy Instruments to Improve Nutrition: Challenges and Opportunities.
papers.abstract: Economic policy can be a powerful instrument to influence food environments and support improved diets and health. Over the past 20 years, the use of fiscal policy to improve diets has increased dramatically. This paper reviews the trajectory of policy change, and explores the ways in which research has informed three different dimensions of economic policy change in relation to nutrition: policy paradigms, policy instruments and policy settings. The increasing use of fiscal policy contrasts to more limited use of other economic policy instruments, including trade policy, to shape food environments for improved nutrition. Insights from the case studies explored in this paper indicate the important role of research in supporting policy change, including through generating evidence that speaks to sectoral needs and priorities, which can enable policy makers to identify and support potential synergies, as well as providing evidence from real-world evaluations of policy measures. The case studies also highlight the importance of constructive engagement between nutrition and economic policy makers. Finally, the paper identifies three considerations for research moving forward related to policy innovation, knowledge equity, and gender.
papers.summary: 本文回顧了過去二十年利用經濟政策工具改善營養的發展軌跡，指出財政政策的應用顯著增加，但貿易等其他經濟手段的使用仍然有限。研究探討了學術證據如何影響政策範式、工具及設置的變革，強調了通過產生滿足部門需求的證據及現實世界評估，來促進營養與經濟政策制定者之間的建設性合作。
papers.classification: 營養政策與衛生經濟學
papers.significance: 本研究的意義在於揭示了經濟政策，尤其是財政手段在重塑食物環境以促進公共健康方面的潛力與進展。它強調了科學證據在促成政策制定者協同合作中的關鍵作用，並為未來在政策創新、知識公平及性別維度的深入研究提供了指導方向，有助於制定更有效的營養改善策略。

papers.title: How Much Does It Cost the South Korean Public Healthcare System to Produce One Healthy Life Year?
papers.abstract: Investigating the impact of healthcare expenditure on health is crucial for optimizing public resource allocation. This can inform the value of expanding healthcare budgets and provide a benchmark for allocations within healthcare systems. However, empirical evidence remains mixed. The potential causes of mixed results-reverse causality and unobservable confounders-need to be addressed through robust empirical methods. This study assesses the South Korean public healthcare cost of producing one quality-adjusted life year (QALY) by using conversion factors-elements in the pricing formula of healthcare services determined by negotiations-as the instrument, with two-way fixed effects. Moreover, since morbidity significantly affects health, it is crucial to estimate the impact of healthcare expenditure on morbidity using credible data. We use a unique dataset of directly measured regional EQ-5D indices from 240 municipalities for the period 2008-2019, which is unavailable in other countries. We estimate that $12,847 of public healthcare expenditure is required to gain one QALY. Sensitivity analyses using alternative calculation methods, data, and models produce estimates ranging from $8850 to $17,674 per QALY. Our findings suggest that the healthcare cost of producing one QALY is substantially lower than the GDP per capita and the willingness-to-pay for health in South Korea.
papers.summary: 本研究利用醫療服務定價公式中的轉換因子作為工具變數，採用雙向固定效應模型，基於2008年至2019年間240個自治區的獨特EQ-5D實測數據，評估南韓公共醫療體系產生一個質量調整生命年（QALY）的成本。結果顯示，每增加一個QALY約需12,847美元的公共醫療支出，敏感度分析的估計範圍則在8,850至17,674美元之間。
papers.significance: 此研究透過穩健的實證方法解決了反向因果關係等問題，為醫療支出對健康的影響提供了明確的證據。研究發現南韓獲得一個QALY的成本顯著低於其人均GDP及健康支付意願，這為優化公共資源分配、評估醫療預算擴張的價值以及制定醫療體系內部的資金配置基準提供了重要的政策參考。
